meta.name: request-refactor-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed refactor plan with tiny commits via user interview, then file it as a GitHub issue. Use when user wants to plan a refactor, create a refactoring RFC, or break a refactor into safe incremental steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把重构拆成安全的小步提交并创建 GitHub Issue
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把大型重构拆成可安全提交的小步骤
copy.tagline_en: Break refactoring into safe small commits and file a GitHub issue
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to break a large refactor into safe incremental steps

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会通过提问帮你梳理代码重构计划，然后自动在 GitHub 上创建一个包含详细步骤的 issue。
howto.when: 当你提出想要重构代码、制定重构方案或把重构拆成安全的小步骤时触发。

say.text: 我想重构这个项目的用户模块，帮我做个计划。
say.note: Claude 会开始提问了解你的需求。

say.text: 帮我把这个重构拆成最小的安全提交步骤。
say.note: Claude 会分析代码并生成提交计划。

say.text: 创建一个重构的 RFC 文档并提交到 GitHub issue。
say.note: Claude 会生成 issue 并发布。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will ask questions to help you plan a code refactor, then automatically create a GitHub issue with a detailed step-by-step plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to plan a refactor, create a refactoring RFC, or break a refactor into safe incremental steps.

say_en.text: I want to refactor the user module, help me make a plan.
say_en.note: Claude will start asking questions to understand your needs.

say_en.text: Break this refactor into the smallest safe commits.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the code and generate a commit plan.

say_en.text: Create a refactoring RFC and file it as a GitHub issue.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the issue and post it.
